To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

there is a paucity of research on carers' attitudes and their impact on the quality of care; there is a lack of research about the culture of health care institutions and their effect on the quality of patient-care; there is a pauciity of research on patients' attitudes to care and their effect on care; and there is a lack on research into the relationship between patients' attitudes to carers, and the quality of patient carer relationships.
there is a paucity of research into the attitudes of health care workers and patients to each other and the effects of such attitudes on care.
there is a need for more research on the attitudes of health care workers and carers, including those in the community and 'housekeeping staff'.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the attitudes of professional health care workers towards people with HIV/AIDS and their impact on the quality of care given.
the quality of care given to people with HIV/AIDS and the barriers to this care.
the attitudes of carers towards patients and the attitudes of patients towards carers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a lack of research in this area.
the attitudes of health professionals to people with HIV/AIDS are important and do affect the care they receive.
the attitudes of health care workers to people with HIV/AIDS are of importance and should be investigated further, but the evidence available is inconclusive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the attitudes of health care workers and patients to each other are important factors in the quality of care given.
there is an urgent need for more research in this area, especially into the attitudes of people with HIV/AIDS and their carers, to improve the quality and effectiveness of care.
there is a need for more research on the attitudes of patients, carers and the organizations in which they work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need for more research into the attitudes of carers and patients towards each other.
the attitudes of carers towards people with HIV/AIDS can be improved by education and training.
there is a need for more studies on the attitudes of health care workers and patients with HIV/AIDS towards each other.
